q: Proficient in managing Windows/Linux servers, Active Directory, and virtualization platforms (VMware/Hyper-V).
Strong understanding of networking concepts, including VLANs, firewalls, VPNs, and load balancing.
Skilled in storage, backup, and disaster recovery solutions ensuring business continuity.
Experience with monitoring tools and automation (PowerShell, Bash, Ansible).
Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills with a focus on high availability and security.
Effective communicator and team player with the ability to work in fast-paced environments.
Experience: IT Infrastructure: 0 - 2 years of experience in IT Infrastructure or related field.
Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field.
Language: Excellent command of oral and written English and prefer Arabic.
